contexts.text: Hence the face is called the... index of the mind. AC 10587:2. HH 91. SE 1376:end. SE 1388. AE 412:22.
This number is as it were the index of the subject treated of.
These three marks, witnesses, and indices, that faith in the Lord is faith itself...
Like the wind-pointer over roofs and ships.
The first tribe is the index, from which are determined the things which follow. AE 431:14.
